feeds.title: The Studying With Dyslexia Blog
feeds.description: A blog about studying with dyslexia. Read about aspects of supporting students showing symptoms of dyslexia or who have attended a dyslexia test.

feeds.title: Dyslexia Assist - By Parents and Children Blog
feeds.description: Dyslexia Assist is a small charity started by parents with dyslexic children to share information, tips, ideas and experiences and tutors. Find parent blogs sharing advice and experience of helping children with dyslexia, also find ideas so children can help each other, share your experience too.

feeds.title: Codebreakers Blog
feeds.description: CodeBreakers has become an in-depth screening and teaching practice that is accessible to both schools and individuals. It is primarily a tuition service that can also train organisations/groups on awareness of dyslexia and train school staff to deliver an effective dyslexia programme. Keep up to date with all things Codebreakers, read our blog posts and discover more about dyslexia and how we can help boost your spelling and literacy.

feeds.title: Dyslexia A2Z Blog
feeds.description: Maria Chivers is the founder of Dyslexia A2Z. She is an international author on dyslexia and other learning difficulties. Read articles on Dyslexia, Dyscalculia, Dysgraphia, Dyspraxia, ADHD, and other learning difficulties.

feeds.title: Dyslexia UK Blog
feeds.description: Dyslexia UK provides remote SEND support for schools and colleges both within the UK and Internationally. They also provide training, assessment, and other resources to help families affected by Dyslexia. This blog explores various challenges, difficulties faced by Dyslexic patients and offers tips, ideas to help prevent of mitigate them.

feeds.title: QuickScreen Dyslexia Test Blog
feeds.description: QuickScreen is a cost effective way of screening for dyslexia. Read our blog for more help with identifying and dealing with the symptoms of dyslexia. Also sharing dyslexia news & offering an online dyslexia test for individuals & organisations.

feeds.title: Dyslexia Norfolk Blog
feeds.description: Ines G Grote is a qualified Dyslexia Tutor who provides programs to help with reading and writing difficulties, Dyslexia, Dyspraxia, ADHD and Dyscalculia.
